Class GameDataLoader

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.factories.GameDataLoader
public class GameDataLoader extends Object
Handles the loading, parsing, and assembly of game components from JSON resource files.

This class serves as the primary data loader for the game engine. It utilizes the Jackson ObjectMapper to read structured card definition templates and delegates instantiation to a centralized CardFactory.

It enforces structural game rules during setup, such as:

  • Filtering out cards that do not match the minimum player count requirements.
  • Shuffling and grouping character and event decks dynamically by their corresponding Era.
  • Enforcing building card pool limitations across Eras and player counts via a configuration lookup table.
  • Injecting game-ending final events at the bottom of the main gameplay stack.

  • Method Details

    • loadDecks

      public List<TribeDeck> loadDecks(int playersNum)
      Loads, shuffles, and constructs the main game deck consisting of character and non-final event cards, capped off with a randomized selection of endgame final events.

      The loading workflow strictly adheres to chronological game requirements:

      1. Filters out raw card definitions failing the minPlayers restriction.
      2. Separates and shuffles cards internally within Era 1, Era 2, and Era 3 respectively to preserve chronological escalation.
      3. Extracts specialized final event cards assigned to Era 3, shuffles them, and appends a maximum of 2 to the absolute bottom of the composite stack.
      Parameters:
      playersNum - the total number of players participating in the current session
      Returns:
      a fully prepared, chronologically stacked List of TribeDeck elements ready for gameplay

    • loadAllTribeCardsById

      public Map<String, TribeDeck> loadAllTribeCardsById(int playersNum)
      Generates a structural dictionary mapping every player-accessible main deck card ID to its fully constructed domain model representation.

      This method bypasses shuffling and deck partitioning logic. It is primarily used during game setup, testing, or state restoration to map raw action logs or network packages back to concrete entities.

      Parameters:
      playersNum - the total number of players participating in the current session
      Returns:
      a Map linking unique card ID string values to their corresponding TribeDeck object instances

    • loadBuildings

      public List<BuildingCard> loadBuildings(int era, int playersNum)
      Extracts a randomized pool of building cards matching a targeted era and tailored to the specific sizing demands of the current player configuration.

      The total number of cards returned is strictly looked up from CONFIG_TABLE.

      Parameters:
      era - the target historical era (must be between 1 and 3 inclusive)
      playersNum - the total number of active players (must be between 2 and 5 inclusive)
      Returns:
      a randomly shuffled, bounded List containing the designated number of BuildingCards
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provided era or player arguments violate system boundaries

    • loadAllBuildingCardsById

      public Map<String, BuildingCard> loadAllBuildingCardsById(int playersNum)
      Compiles an exhaustive map of all historical structural building cards across all eras that satisfy the current game setup's player boundaries.

      Iterates through all era templates sequentially, indexing every eligible building entity by its ID string.

      Parameters:
      playersNum - the total number of players participating in the current session (must be between 2 and 5 inclusive)
      Returns:
      a comprehensive Map linking building ID strings to their fully populated BuildingCard instances
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provided player value falls outside allowable bounds

    • loadOfferTrack

      public OfferTrack loadOfferTrack(int numPlayers)
      Assembles and wraps an operational shared OfferTrack layout populated with static, hardcoded trade or resource configurations.

      Tiles whose structural minimum player limits exceed the actual player roster size are automatically excluded.

      Parameters:
      numPlayers - the total number of players participating in the current session
      Returns:
      a new, isolated OfferTrack state instance containing valid tiles for the specified player count
